description: DESTRUCTIVE: make a branch this token created an exact copy of another branch – the token's base by default, or another branch this token created (`from`). Every label on the branch is replaced with the source's (values, statuses, comments, context, tags) and keys the source lacks are removed; it cannot be undone. Unlike delete_branch + create_branch, the branch keeps its name and every API token bound to it keeps working. Requires the developer role or higher. The QA merge gate checks the texts it brings in, as for a merge, into the branch and can refuse it with qa_gate_blocked (tokens cannot override). Only reset when the user asks for it; returns how many keys were written and removed.

branch.description: The branch to reset (must be one this token created; never main).

from.description: The branch to copy: the token's base or another branch this token created. Defaults to the branch's own base.

name: reset_branch
title: Reset Branch
